desk_read: Yesterday’s session showed broad downward price pressure across most monitored contracts paired with active volume above 20-day averages in energy and metals. Crude complex positioning expanded with new shorts in both WTI and Brent alongside firm backwardation, while Natural Gas rallied +2.42% on short covering with total open interest dropping -13.8k contracts (-1.0%) and volume running at 1.7x its 20-day average. In equity indices, the S&P 500 saw prices decline -0.40% while total open interest rose +13.8k contracts (+0.7%) on new shorts, contrasting with Nasdaq 100 long liquidation where total open interest fell -3.8k contracts (-1.3%). Gold also experienced long liquidation with total open interest down -1.4k contracts (-0.3%).
